title: The Beurling density of the spectrum of self-similar measure generated by Hadamard triple
summary: Let $D\subset\Bbb Z$ with cardinality $q\ge 2$, and let $b\in \Bbb Z$ with $q<b$, and let $μ:=μ_{b,D}$ be the associated self-similar measure. It is well known that if there exists $L\subset \Bbb Z$ such that $(b,D,L)$ be a Hadamard triple, then the Beurling dimension of the spectrum of $μ$ exhibits an intermediate structural property. In this paper, we establish a stronger result that both Beurling dimension and Beurling density of the spectra of $μ$ can achieve full flexibility simultaneously.
